record.question: Why was the Battle of Buxar (1764) decisive in consolidating British control in northern India?
options: It ended all resistance from the Marathas
It gave the Company control over Bombay and Madras
It led to the annexation of Punjab and the neighbouring areas giving economic power to the British
It defeated a coalition of major Indian powers, giving the Company political supremacy in the Ganga plain
